entities.name: Glutamate-1-semialdehyde aminomutase
observations: The 417-residue query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt A4YD91, annotated as glutamate-1-semialdehyde 2,1-aminomutase.
The enzyme is PLP-dependent and contains the conserved catalytic lysine modified by pyridoxal phosphate at the homologous position 259.
Pfam analysis identifies an Aminotran_3 domain spanning residues 25–383.

source_tools.relevance: Exact sequence identity, catalytic annotation, PLP-linked lysine, and domain evidence

entities.name: Glutamate-1-semialdehyde aminomutation
observations: The reaction is (S)-4-amino-5-oxopentanoate = 5-aminolevulinate, commonly written as glutamate-1-semialdehyde ⇌ 5-aminolevulinate.
This is an intramolecular amino-group rearrangement rather than a net oxidation or reduction.

source_tools.relevance: Curated EC and Rhea reaction assignment

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5-phosphate
observations: PLP is the required cofactor for the enzyme; ChEBI:CHEBI:597326.
A covalent PLP–lysine internal aldimine is supported by the curated modified-residue annotation in homologs.

entities.name: Protoporphyrin IX biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme catalyzes the second and final step converting glutamyl-tRNA-derived glutamate-1-semialdehyde to 5-aminolevulinate in tetrapyrrole biosynthesis.
